Emberwatch fire test marker

The drone treats this code as a large fire with the details below.

NameAlpha
Area120 ha
Intensityextreme
Spread rate35 m/min
Fueldry mixed forest and grass
Wind30 km/h toward 60°
Temperature31 °C
Humidity18 %

Print at 100% scale (no "fit to page"); the code must measure 18 cm per side — the bridge uses that size to work out how far away the fire is. Lay it flat on the floor or a table in an open, well-lit spot, away from glare. The drone flies its demo circle with the camera tilted down, so the marker should sit about 1–2 m from the take-off point.
